messages:
Alex R: Quick flag — we have a coverage gap for the US/EMEA long weekend. Primary for Sat 03/28 was listed as Maria but she just messaged OOO. Need someone to cover primary or take primary->secondary handoff. :rotating_light:

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled primary/secondary list for 2026-03-28 to 2026-03-29 - Primary: Maria T, Secondary: Cheng Wu. Please post a handoff note if you swap.

Maria T: Sorry team, just landed and my phone died on the flight. I can only be on-call intermittently from 09:00-12:00 UTC that day. If there's heavy paging I won't be reliable. Really sorry, didn't expect flight issues. :disappointed:

Samira K: I can pick up primary for Sat if needed. I'm available 00:00-16:00 UTC and can swing on-call phone. Would prefer to stay primary for both Sat/Sun if no one objects.

Cheng Wu: Thanks Samira. I'm happy to be secondary those windows. If Samira takes primary, I'll be the escalation.

Leo P: I can cover the late shift 16:00-23:59 UTC Sat but can't do the overnight. Happy to take a chunk.

Alex R: Thanks. Important bits: 1) We need someone to accept PD schedule so alerts route properly. 2) Runbook link -> https://redwood.internal/runbooks/serving-incidents (use the 'holiday-latency' section). 3) If primary can't ack within 5min, PD auto-esc to secondary, then to oncall-sre.

Samira K: I'll update PD now and take primary for Sat. Doing the rotation in PD (watch for confirmation).

deploy-bot: PagerDuty schedule updated by Samira K — Primary: Samira K, Secondary: Cheng Wu. Change effective 2026-03-28 00:00 UTC.

Samira K: Hand-off note: accepted primary for Sat 00:00-16:00 UTC. Contact cell +1-415-555-0142. If paging: first check RC queues and autoscaler (/status/gpu-pools).

Alex R: Copy. A couple of runbook pointers to paste into your note: 
```
- Check /status/serving for CPU/GPU throttles
- Confirm model pool health: curl -s https://infraapi.internal/pools/health | jq .
- If latency > 300ms P95 for > 10m, hit the 'scale-pool' playbook
- Fallback: switch route to smallest-compatible model variant (see routing matrix)
```

Cheng Wu: Added escalation contact for Samira in the runbook: @Cheng Wu will be secondary. If Samira can't reach PD or it's >30m unresolved and customers impacted, page oncall-sre and add incident-channel.

Alex R: Customer impact note — we have 2 enterprise customers on Dedicated in EU region with scheduled jobs Sat morning (approx 08:00-11:00 UTC). If you see model timeouts or bursty 502s, prioritize restoring model pools and error budget checks. Customer success is being notified AFAICT.

Samira K: Acknowledged. Quick checklist I'll run for any page: 
1) Confirm scope (hosted vs dedicated)
2) Confirm impacted model/version
3) Check autoscaler events and logs -> /logs/autoscaler
4) If dedicated customer, spare to fallback region per vault routing policy

Alex R: One more operational note — if there's an incident that affects the Hosted API and causes >1% error rate for >15m, we trigger an incident channel and status page update. Try to get initial triage in 10m and tag severity.

Leo P: I'll take over the handoff to late shift at 16:00 UTC. Samira, I'll DM for a quick sync at 15:45 UTC.

Samira K: Thanks all. Posting final PD acceptance and phone on. If anyone needs to swap again, please post in this thread and ping oncall-bot. :thumbsup:

Alex R: Closing loop — CS notified, PD updated, runbook pointers in thread. Posting a short handoff checklist in #incidents for visibility. Good team.

incident-bot: Note: if this thread escalates to an incident, runbook 'serving-incident' will be suggested and an incident channel will be created automatically.

Maria T: Thanks everyone for covering, really appreciate it. I'll be reachable 09:00-12:00 UTC to help with context if needed.

Samira K: All set. I'll ack any pages that come through Sat 00:00-16:00 UTC.

Leo P: 15:45 sync confirmed.

Alex R: End of thread — leave a short postmortem note if anything needed for our on-call rotations or runbook clarity. :white_check_mark:
